content: कृ I. €5 <ab>U.</ab> (कृणोति-कृणुते) To hurt, injure, kill. --II. €8 <ab>U.</ab> (करोति-कुरुते, चकार-चक्रे, अकार्षीत्-अकृत; कर्तुम्, करिष्यति-ते कृत) .²1 To do (in general); तात किं करवाण्यहम् .²2 To make; गणिकामवरोधमकरोत् <ls>Dk.</ls>; नृपेण चक्रे युवराजशब्दभाक् <ls>R. 3. 35</ls>; युवराजः कृतः <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 To manufacture, shape, prepare; कुम्भकारो घटं करोति; कटं करोति <ab>&c.</ab> .²4 To build, create; गृहं कुरु; सभां कुरु मदर्थे भोः. .²5 To produce, cause, engender; रतिमुभयप्रार्थना कुरुते <ls>Ś. 2. 1</ls>. .²6 To form, arrange; अञ्जलिं करोति; कपोतहस्तकं कृत्वा. .²7 To write, compose; चकार सुमनोहरं शास्त्रम् <ls>Pt. 1</ls>. .²8 To perform, be engaged in; पूजां करोति. .²9 To tell, narrate; इति बहुविधाः कथाः कुर्वन् <ab>&c.</ab> .²10 To carry out, execute, obey; एवं क्रियते युष्मदादेशः <ls>Māl. 1</ls>; or करिष्यामि वचस्तव or शासनं मे कुरुष्व <ab>&c.</ab> .²11 To bring about, accomplish, effect; सत्संगतिः कथय किं न करोति पुंसाम् <ls>Bh. 2. 23</ls>. .²12 To throw or let out, discharge, emit; मूत्रं कृ to discharge urine, make water; so पुरीषं कृ to void excrement. .²13 To assume, put on, take; स्त्रीरूपं कृत्वा; नानारूपाणि कुर्वाणः <ls>Y. 3. 162</ls>. .²14 To send forth, utter; मानुषीं गिरं कृत्वा, कलरवं कृत्वा <ab>&c.</ab> .²15 To place or put on (with <ab>loc.</ab>); कण्ठे हारमकरोत् <ls>K. 212</ls>; पाणिमुरसि कृत्वा <ab>&c.</ab> .²16 To entrust (with some duty), appoint; अध्यक्षान् विविधान्कुर्यात्तत्र तत्र विपश्चितः <ls>Ms. 7. 81</ls>. .²17 To cook (as food) as in कृतान्नम्. .²18 To think, regard, consider; दृष्टिस्तृणीकृतजगत्त्रयसत्त्वसारा <ls>U. 6. 19</ls>. .²19 To take (as in the hand); कुरु करे गुरुमेकमयोघनं <ls>N. 4. 59</ls>. .²20 To make a sound, as in खात्कृत्य, फूत्कृत्य भुङ्क्ते; so वषट्कृ, स्वाहाकृ <ab>&c.</ab> .²21 To pass, spend (time); वर्षाणि दश चक्रुः spent; क्षणं कुरु wait a moment. .²22 To direct towards, turn the attention to, resolve on; (with <ab>loc.</ab> or <ab>dat.</ab>); नाधर्मे कुरुते मनः <ls>Ms. 12. 118</ls>; नगरगमनाय मतिं न करोति <ls>Ś. 2</ls>. .²23 To do a thing for another (either for his advantage or injury); प्राप्ताग्निनिर्वापणगर्वमम्बु रत्नाङ्कुरज्योतिषि किं करोति <ls>Vikr. 1. 18</ls>, <ls n="Vikr.">18</ls>; यदनेन कृतं मयि, असौ किं मे करिष्यति <ab>&c.</ab> .²24 To use, employ, make use of; किं तया क्रियते धेन्वा <ls>Pt. 1</ls>. .²25 To divide, break into parts (with adverbs ending in धा); द्विधा कृ to divide into two parts; शतधा कृ, सहस्रधा कृ <ab>&c.</ab> .²26 To cause to become subject to, reduce completely to (a particular condition, with adverbs ending in सात्); आत्मसात् कृ to subject or appropriate to oneself; दुरितैरपि कर्तुमात्मसात्प्रयतन्ते नृपसूनवो हि यत् <ls>R. 8. 2</ls>; भस्मसात् कृ to reduce to ashes. .²27 To appropriate, secure for oneself. .²28 To help, give aid. .²29 To make liable. .²30 To violate or outrage (as a girl). .²31 To begin. .²32 To order. .²33 To free from. .²34 To proceed with, put in practice. .²35 To worship, sacrifice. .²36 To make like, consider equal to, <ab>cf.</ab> तृणीकृ (said to be <ab>Ātm.</ab> only in the last 10 senses). .²37 To take up, gather; आदाने करोतिशब्दः <ls>Ms. 4. 2. 6</ls>; यथा काष्ठानि करोति गोमयानि करोति इति आदाने करोतिशब्दो भवति एवमिहापि द्रष्टव्यम् <ls>ŚB. on MS. 4. 2. 6</ls>. This root is often used with nouns, adjectives, and indeclinables to form verbs from them, somewhat like the <lang>English</lang> affixes ‘en’ or ‘(i) fy’, in the sense of ‘making a person or thing to be what it previously is not’; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} कृष्णीकृ to make that which is not already black, black, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} blacken; so श्वेतीकृ to whiten; घनीकृ to solidify; विरलीकृ to rarefy <ab>&c.</ab> <ab>&c.</ab> Sometimes these formations take place in other senses also; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} क्रोडीकृ ‘to clasp to the bosom’, embrace; भस्मीकृ to reduce to ashes; प्रवणीकृ to incline, bend; तृणीकृ to value as little as straw; मन्दीकृ to slacken, make slow; so शूलीकृ to roast on the end of pointed lances; सुखीकृ to please; समयाकृ to spend time <ab>&c.</ab> {%<ab>N. B.</ab>%} This root by itself admits of either Pada; but it is <ab>Ātm.</ab> generally with prepositions in the following senses:-- (1) doing injury to; (2) censure, blame; (3) serving; (4) outraging, acting violently or rashly; (5) preparing, changing the condition of, turning into; (6) reciting; (7) employing, using; see <ls>P. I. 3. 32</ls> and गन्धनावक्षेपणसेवनसाहसिक्यप्रतियत्नप्रकथनोपयोगेषु कृञः “Studentsʼ Guide to Sanskrit Composition” § 338. {%Note%}. The root कृ is of the most frequent application in Sanskrit literature, and its senses are variously modified, or almost infinitely extended, according to the noun with which the root is connected; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} पदं कृ to set foot (<ab>fig.</ab> also); आश्रमे पदं करिष्यसि <ls>Ś. 4. 19</ls>; क्रमेण कृतं मम वपुषि नवयौवनेन पदम् <ls>K. 141</ls>; मनसा कृ to think of, meditate; मनसि कृ to think; दृष्ट्वा मनस्येवमकरोत् <ls>K. 136</ls>; or to resolve or determine; सख्यम्, मैत्रीं कृ to form friendship with; अस्त्राणि कृ to practise the use of weapons; दण्डं कृ to inflict punishment; हृदये कृ to pay heed to; कालं कृ to die; मतिं-बुद्धिं कृ to think of, intend, mean; उदकं कृ to offer libations of water to manes; चिरं कृ to delay; दर्दुरं कृ to play on the lute; नखानि कृ to clean the nails; कन्यां कृ to outrage or violate a maiden; विना कृ to separate from, to be abandoned by, as in मदनेन विनाकृता रतिः <ls>Ku. 4. 21</ls>; मध्ये कृ to place in the middle, to have reference to; मध्येकृत्य स्थितं क्रथकौशिकान् <ls>M. 5. 2</ls>; वशे कृ to win over, place in subjection, subdue; चमत्कृ to cause surprise; make an exhibition or a show; सत्कृ to honour, treat with respect; तिर्यक्कृ to place aside. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (कारयति-ते) To cause to do, perform, make, execute <ab>&c.</ab>; आज्ञां कारय रक्षोभिः <ls>Bk. 8. 84</ls>; भृत्यं भृत्येन वा कटं कारयति <ls>Sk.</ls> --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (चिकीर्षतिते) To wish to do <ab>&c.</ab>; <ls>Śi. 14. 41</ls>.
वह्निसात् कृ To consume with fire, burn.
